$comment: HAND-OWNED config for `pnpm rtx core drizzle-manifest` (ts-go-runtypes/cmd/gen-drizzle-manifest). The single place that says which drizzle dialects are supported: their drizzle module, the proxy file that wraps it, and the manifest file (generated next to this config) that records coverage. To add a dialect, add a row here and regenerate. `packageDir` and `proxy` are repo-root-relative; `manifest` is a plain file name in this directory.
